title: How many cups of tea are consumed daily in Mumbai?
clarifyingQuestions: Are we counting only chai (milk tea) or all tea variants including green/black tea?

keyAssumptions: Mumbai Metropolitan Region population is ~21 million
~70% of the population are adults (18+)
80% of adults are regular tea drinkers
Average tea drinker has 3 cups per day (morning, break, evening)
coreEquation: Daily Cups = Adult Population × Tea Drinker % × Avg Cups per Drinker per Day

items.sourceOrLogic: 2024 metro population estimate (Census-based projection)

items.label: Adult population (18+ years)
items.sourceOrLogic: Standard Indian demographic adult-share split

items.label: % of adults who drink tea regularly
items.sourceOrLogic: Assumed given tea's cultural dominance over coffee in Mumbai/Maharashtra

steps.formula: Total Cups = Adults × Drinker % × Cups per Day

items.label: Average cups per tea drinker per day
items.sourceOrLogic: Typical pattern: morning cup, office/tapri break, evening cup

finalAnswer: ~35 million cups of tea are consumed daily in Mumbai.
interviewerTips: Anchor on population before layering behavioral assumptions — it signals structured thinking.
State explicitly whether you're including office pantries and street tapris, since interviewers often probe channel mix next.

sanityCheck: 35M cups / 21M population ≈ 1.7 cups per capita per day including non-drinkers — plausible for a tea-heavy city, not an outlier.
